name: Salem
intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Salem for 2026, and here is what he found: 21 family events across Salem and nearby towns, 8 of them free. The magic runs from late November through December 31, with the Downtown Salem Holiday Parade (November 27), the Annual Tree Lighting Ceremony (December 1) and Sleeping Beauty's Holiday Tea Party (December 13) along the way. New in this update: Holiday Fest in Downtown Stayton (November 27 and 28), Christmas in the Park in Aumsville (December 12), Home Alone 2 with Santa at the Elsinore Theatre (December 17) and Salem Tuba Holiday at the Elsinore Theatre (December 24). We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Salem

  • 21 Christmas events for kids in Salem and nearby towns, including Brooks, Stayton and Aumsville
  • 8 free events, including the Downtown Salem Holiday Parade, the Annual Tree Lighting Ceremony and Holiday Fest in Downtown Stayton
  • Meet Santa: Magic at the Mill (November 27), Home Alone 2 with Santa at the Elsinore Theatre (December 17) and Christmas in the Park in Aumsville (December 12)
  • Parades, tree lightings and music: the Downtown Salem Holiday Parade (November 27), the Annual Tree Lighting Ceremony (December 1), the Stayton tree lighting at Holiday Fest (November 27 and 28) and Salem Tuba Holiday (December 24)
  • Trains: Holiday Sparkles at Powerland in Brooks
  • Season: late November to December 31

Planning a bigger day out? Salem families also use our guide to Christmas events for kids in Portland, which covers ZooLights, the Holiday Express steam train, Peacock Lane and more.
